tasks.title: Conversation #62
tasks.transcript:
Man: Have you heard they're finally updating the kitchen in the student lounge of this dormitory?
Woman: It's about time. What are they doing?
Man: Well, for one, all of the appliances are being replaced.
Woman: Oh, that's great. The microwave hasn't been working properly for a while.
Man: I heard they're replacing some of the cabinets too.
Woman: I hope it doesn't take too long. I cook there a lot.
Man: Me too. I think we'll have access to the place in the dorm next door though.

questions.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：两个人主要在讨论什么？ 定位原文：they're finally updating the kitchen… appliances are being replaced… cabinets too 选项分析： A. A new student study area 新学习区。文中未提到，所以错误。 B. Some kitchen renovations 一些厨房翻新。基于 appliances 和 cabinets 被更换，这正是讨论内容，因此正确。 C. Upgrades to some dorm rooms 宿舍升级。范围不准确，所以错误。 D. Facilities at a nearby dormitory 附近宿舍设施。只是提到备用，不是主题，所以错误。

questions.stem: What is the woman concerned about?

options.B: Learning how to use new equipment
options.D: Having to look for a new roommate

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：女生担心什么？ 定位原文：I hope it doesn't take too long. I cook there a lot. 选项分析： A. Paying for some campus services 付费问题。未提及，所以错误。 B. Learning how to use new equipment 学设备。未提及，所以错误。 C. Losing access to a facility 失去使用场地。因为她常用厨房，担心无法使用，因此正确。 D. Having to look for a new roommate 找室友。无关，所以错误。
